title: Hearing on crowding and conditions in NYC youth jails
summary: The Council's Committee on Children and Youth is examining conditions at the City's two secure juvenile detention facilities, Crossroads and Horizon, which held 374 youth combined as of October 2026 despite a certified capacity of 244 beds. The hearing also covers four bills and a resolution addressing alternatives to detention, review of detained youth populations, training on sexually exploited youth, and a call for state Raise the Age funding the City has never received. Officials cite a June 2026 violent incident at Horizon, rising average lengths of stay, and a lapsed state waiver on bed capacity as key issues.
